name: Drug–Drug Interaction Prediction Benchmark under Distribution Shift
description: A benchmark assessing drug–drug interaction prediction methods, particularly their robustness and performance under distributional changes.
reputation: Niche but growing benchmark in pharmacoinformatics for testing DDI models under distribution shift; used in specialized robustness studies.
notes: High contamination risk if training data contains known drug pairs; class imbalance common; performance sensitive to dataset split/shift strategy; relatively specialized, non-LLM benchmark focused on molecular/graph models.
